Off Market Venture
Vasant Kunj, New Delhi - 110070
+91 99681 10807 | https://www.offmarketventure.co/
DEAL CONFIRMATION NOTE
To, {{ buyer.entity_name if buyer else doc.buyer_profile }} ({{ buyer.pan if buyer else '' }})
Subject: Deal contract of ({{ stock_doc.company_name if stock_doc else doc.stock }})
We confirm trade as follows, the details are given below.
DEAL DETAILS
NATURE OF TRANSACTION SELLING of EQUITY SHARES – {{ stock_doc.company_name if stock_doc else doc.stock }}
ISIN NO {{ doc.isin_number or '' }}
CONFIRMATION DATE {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.confirmation_date, "dd-mm-yyyy") if doc.confirmation_date else '' }}
QUANTITY (NO OF SHARES) {{ "{:,.0f}".format(doc.quantity or 0) }}
RATE PER SHARE (₹) ₹{{ "{:,.2f}".format(doc.buyer_rate or 0) }}
STAMP DUTY (0.015%) ₹{{ "{:,.2f}".format(doc.stamp_duty or 0) }}
TCS ({{ "{:,.2f}".format(doc.tcs_rate) if doc.tcs_applicable else "0.00" }}%) ₹{{ "{:,.2f}".format(doc.tcs_value or 0) }}
TOTAL TRANSACTION VALUE (₹) ₹{{ "{:,.2f}".format(doc.total_net_due or 0) }}
MODE OF DELIVERY "DEMAT"
BUYER DP ID {{ buyer.dp_id or '' }}
BUYER CLIENT ID {{ buyer.client_id or '' }}
BANK DETAILS FOR RTGS / NEFT / IMPS — Pay to Off Market Venture
BANK NAME {{ bank.bank_name or '' }}
ACCOUNT NO {{ bank.account_no or '' }}
NAME {{ bank.company_name or '' }}
IFSC {{ bank.ifsc or '' }}
BRANCH {{ bank.branch or '' }}
ACCOUNT TYPE CURRENT ACCOUNT
DP ID {{ bank.dp_id or '' }}
CLIENT ID {{ bank.client_id or '' }}
DP NAME SMC GLOBAL SECURITIES LTD
PAN {{ bank.pan or '' }}
IMPORTANT NOTICE & DISCLAIMER

The Buyer is required to provide the following details: Name, Address, PAN Card, Client Master List copy (CML), Bank Account Details and UTR number. We/Sellers will ensure the smooth transfer of the agreed number of shares in the Buyer's DEMAT account at an agreed delivery time. Shares will be transferred in the Buyer's DEMAT account as verified by their CML. Third-party transactions are strictly prohibited.

By confirming the above deal or by transferring the monies in our account, Buyer/yourself is confirming you are aware that the aforesaid deal/transaction is in your name account and commensurate with your income, net worth, general/business profile and risk taking appetite. Buyer/Representative unconditionally and irrevocably confirms and declares that she has taken a conscious decision to invest in the above-mentioned securities.

Buyer also fully understands the various risks associated with the investment: (a) Credit Risk — inability of the issuer to service obligations, (b) Liquidity Risk — inability to find ready liquidity, (c) Instrument Risk — risks from nature/status of instrument, (d) Capital Risk — risk that a client can lose capital invested because of market conditions.

Buyer hereby agrees that in case the Seller is not able to provide inventory for whatsoever reason, the Seller will return the transaction amount in the same Bank account without any penalty or interest. During high volatility, the Seller has a right to cancel the deal and refund the consideration amount to the client.

Buyer confirms that s/he has neither been influenced nor given any assurance of guaranteed/fixed returns/capital protection by OMV or its associates. Any representation on financial numbers or IPO dates can change and Seller is not responsible for Profit or Loss arising from any communications.

The buyer is aware that there is no assurance of exit and listing date and we provide no clarity whether the IPO will be announced or not. Unlisted Shares are subject to lock-in for 6 months from the date of listing. Buyer confirms the Company is a transactional platform, not a stock exchange or advisory firm.

Buyer confirms it is the Buyer's responsibility to ensure receipt of shares within 48 hours. The Buyer agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold the Company harmless against any losses, claims, damages, or liabilities that may arise as a result of the above transaction.
Looking forward to a long-term relationship.
Best Regards,

ANSHUL BHARDWAJ
This document is system-generated and does not require a physical signature unless specifically requested.
